name: Library
description: The user's own library of API toolkits: for a service, the agent researches its API, asks the user for the key it needs (never seeing it), and saves small JavaScript functions that call it, to run again on request or on a schedule. Call guide first, for how. Not ready yet: only guide works.
author: anythingllm-suite
